High Court Of Madhya Pradesh
 At Gwalior
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Shri Rajkumar Joshi - Advocate for the appellant.
Shri Vikram Pippal - P.P. for the respondent/State.
Heard on I.A. No.5998/2026 , which is an application for change of counsel.
In view of the reasons assigned, the application is allowed.
Shri R.K. Joshi, Advocate and his associates are permitted to appear and argue on behalf of appellant.
Also heard on I.A.No.5999/2026, second application under Section 389(1) of Cr.P.C. for suspension of jail sentence and grant of bail on behalf of appellant.

This Criminal Appeal has been preferred under Section 374 of the Cr.P.C. against the judgment of conviction and order of sentence dated 17.11.2011 passed by Additional Sessions Judge, Karera,
District Shivpuri in Case No.97/2010, whereby present appellant has been convicted under Section 366 of IPC and sentenced to undergo 5 years with fine of Rs.1000/- and under Section 376 (1) of IPC & sentenced to undergo 10 years RI with fine of Rs.2200/- with default stipulation.

entities.text:
Additional Sessions Judge, Karera,
District Shivpuri
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Record indicates that vide order dated 02.02.2012 the sentence awarded to the appellant was suspended.

Thereafter, the appellant did not appear before the Registry of this Court and therefore,
the warrant of arrest was issued and vide order dated 16.3.2026, the appellant was sent to Sub-Jail Karera, District Shivpuri.

The counsel appearing for the appellant submits that the non-appearance of 2 CRA-972-2011 the appellant before the Registry of this Court was due to lack of proper communication between the appellant and his counsel.
He submits that the appellant shall now comply with the terms and conditions of the bail order.
Learned counsel for the State opposed the prayer made by the counsel for the appellant and prays for rejection of application.
Heard the counsel for the parties and perused the record.
Considering the facts and circumstances of the case, and without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, the application is allowed.

It is ordered that on furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs. 50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the concerned trial Court, the Ballu vs State Of M.P. on 1 April, 2026 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/79709904/
1 jail sentence of the appellant shall remain suspended till final disposal of this appeal and he be released on bail, subject to deposit of fine amount, if not already deposited.
He is further directed to remain present before the Registry of this Court on 15.07.2026 and, thereafter, on such subsequent dates as may be fixed by the Registry.
I.A.No.5999/2026 stands allowed and disposed of
. IA No.6135/2026, application for urgent hearing, also stands disposed of.
Copy of this order be sent to the trial Court concerned for compliance for the office of this Court.
Certified copy as per rules.
